subject: refactor(text): remove dead RadixTree template and its test (#1432)
reason: The change only deletes dead code: src/indexes/text/radix_tree.h was an unused template header (no remaining file includes it; the live text index uses the rax wrapper in rax_wrapper.h), and the other two hunks remove its unit test (testing/radix_test.cc) and its CMake test registration. No compiled module code path, command, reply, index behaviour, persistence or replication behaviour changes, so there is nothing a fuzzer scenario could reach or distinguish between the two builds.
